item.title: Barclays to lean on AI as it targets £2bn cost cuts and £15bn capital return
item.description: Barclays plans to cut £2bn of costs over three years and ramp up the use of AI as it targets more than £15bn of capital returns to shareholders by 2028. Read more: Barclays to lean on AI as it targets £2bn cost cuts and £15bn capital return

item.title: RoSPA launches expert commission to shape the future of occupational safety skills
item.description: RoSPA has launched a new OSH Skills Commission at the House of Lords, bringing together industry experts to address recruitment, retention and skills gaps in workplace safety. Read more: RoSPA launches expert commission to shape the future of occupational safety skills

item.title: AI energy start-up Tem raises $75m to cut business power bills
item.description: London-based energy tech firm Tem has raised $75m in funding led by Lightspeed Venture Partners as it uses AI to cut business electricity bills by removing wholesale market intermediaries. Read more: AI energy start-up Tem raises $75m to cut business power bills

item.title: Gilt yields jump as pressure mounts on Starmer amid leadership speculation
item.description: UK gilt yields rose as investors sold bonds amid fears of political instability and a possible shift to more left-wing Labour policies following calls for Keir Starmer to step down. Read more: Gilt yields jump as pressure mounts on Starmer amid leadership speculation

item.title: Apple and Google agree UK app store changes after ‘effective duopoly’ ruling
item.description: Apple and Google have agreed to change how their app stores operate in the UK after the CMA ruled they held an effective duopoly, marking a major step in digital market regulation. Read more: Apple and Google agree UK app store changes after ‘effective duopoly’ ruling

item.title: Fractile commits £100m UK expansion as it ramps up AI chip development
item.description: UK chip start-up Fractile is investing £100m to expand operations in London and Bristol, backing Britain’s push for sovereign AI hardware and more efficient inference chips. Read more: Fractile commits £100m UK expansion as it ramps up AI chip development

item.title: Starling founder Anne Boden cuts stake in £4bn fintech
item.description: Starling Bank founder Anne Boden has reduced her shareholding in the digital lender following a secondary share sale that valued the fintech at up to £4bn. Read more: Starling founder Anne Boden cuts stake in £4bn fintech

item.title: Miliband backs solar and wind projects covering farmland nearly the size of Manchester
item.description: Energy secretary Ed Miliband has approved dozens of new solar and onshore wind projects across the UK, sparking a backlash over farmland loss and rising consumer subsidies. Read more: Miliband backs solar and wind projects covering farmland nearly the size of Manchester

item.title: Tariffs and falling demand leave Scotch distillers under pressure
item.description: Dozens of Scottish distilleries are showing signs of financial distress as exports to the US and China weaken, tariffs bite and domestic demand shifts away from spirits. Read more: Tariffs and falling demand leave Scotch distillers under pressure

item.title: Retail spending rebounds in January after weak Christmas
item.description: UK retail sales rose 2.7% year-on-year in January, according to the BRC and KPMG, as shoppers took advantage of post-Christmas discounts following a subdued festive period. Read more: Retail spending rebounds in January after weak Christmas
